name: discodrive-extension
description: DiscoDrive browser extension: server-side downloads, Pocket and bookmark sync for your own cloud

scripts.package: npm run build:release && npx web-ext build -s dist --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:chromium: node build.mjs --release --chromium && npx web-ext build -s dist --overwrite-dest --filename discodrive-{version}-chromium.zip
scripts.sign: npm run build:release && npx web-ext sign -s dist --channel=unlisted --artifacts-dir=web-ext-artifacts
